Notorious Dacoit Jagan Gurjar Found Dead in Ajmer High-Security Jail

Notorious dacoit Jagan Gurjar has been found dead under suspicious circumstances in the high-security Ajmer jail. Police are investigating the death, with initial reports suggesting he was murdered by a fellow inmate following a dispute. Gurjar, known for numerous criminal cases and past incidents, was transferred to the jail previously.
